name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: An unofficial native Debian 13 Proxmox LXC adaptation of the officially Docker-based Nginx Proxy Manager application. It builds the pinned official source and OpenResty environment without installing a nested container runtime.

notes.text: Development status: the native LXC installation and runtime test matrix have not yet been validated on Proxmox. Use only in a disposable test container with a snapshot.
The administration interface is on port 81. HTTP and HTTPS proxy traffic use ports 80 and 443. The internal backend port 3000 and SQLite database remain local to the container.
Nginx Proxy Manager v2.15.1 uses a first-run setup wizard when no administrator exists. This adaptation does not create or display default credentials.
